ideas.idea: Change the default robots meta to index, follow, max-snippet:-1, max-image-preview:large
ideas.why: This is the same as the known max-snippet:0 problem, but the suggested replacement values are specific to Base.astro and would help.

ideas.idea: Consider allowing GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended and anthropic-ai (training crawlers) as a policy choice
ideas.why: The robots.txt already allows everything under User-agent: *, so this is a policy note that applies to any site.
Adding author and date properties to Article is standard advice. It would barely change how this pricing page is found or understood.

ideas.idea: Change Article to Service/Offer/LocalBusiness on the pricing page
ideas.why: The moorings page is about prices and a service, so a different schema type would describe it more accurately.

ideas.idea: Render the FAQ questions and answers visibly in the page body, matching the FAQPage JSON-LD
ideas.why: index.astro emits FAQ JSON-LD with no visible FAQ text, and marked-up content should be visible to users and machines.

ideas.idea: Escape '<' in the JSON-LD serialized with set:html
ideas.why: This is good practice, but the FAQ data is static and trusted, so it has almost no effect here.

ideas.idea: Add astro.config.mjs with site and register the preact integration (plus the preact dependency)
ideas.why: There is no config file, @astrojs/preact is never registered, and Astro.site is needed for the canonical fix, so the Newsletter island would fail to build.

ideas.idea: Replace the hand-written sitemap with @astrojs/sitemap and add lastmod
ideas.why: The hand-written sitemap works, and a generator with lastmod is a common suggestion that makes little difference for three pages.

ideas.idea: Add meta charset and viewport to the head
ideas.why: Base.astro has neither, and a viewport tag is needed for mobile rendering.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter tags
ideas.why: This is standard advice for any site and has little effect on search or AI discovery.
A favicon applies to any site and barely affects discoverability.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/LocalBusiness JSON-LD with address, phone and hours
ideas.why: This is a local harbour business with a phone number on the contact page and no entity markup anywhere, so the markup would help local and entity understanding.

ideas.idea: Fix the 'Harbor' vs 'harbour' spelling inconsistency in the title
ideas.why: The index title says 'Harbor' while the copy and queries use 'harbour', and the fix is a concrete, specific change.

ideas.idea: Expand the one-sentence pages with a table of mooring sizes, seasons and prices
ideas.why: The moorings page has only one price sentence, so a structured table would give people and machines something concrete to read and quote.

ideas.idea: Add address, hours and email to the contact page
ideas.why: The contact page only has a phone number, so these details would help users and assistants.

ideas.idea: Add internal links beyond the navigation
ideas.why: With three pages already linked from the nav, extra internal links would add very little.

ideas.idea: Add type to the Newsletter button and an action or handler to the form
ideas.why: This is a form-quality fix that does nothing for discoverability or understanding.
